convert_paligemma_checkpoint: convert a PaliGemma Flax checkpoint from .npz format to Hugging Face PyTorch weights
build_paligemma_config: build a PaliGemmaConfig object for a specified variant and precision from available model variants
slice_state_dict: slice and reshape a Flax state dict into Hugging Face PaliGemma PyTorch state dict format
flatten_nested_dict: flatten a nested dictionary with slash-separated keys into a flat dictionary
test_convert_paligemma_checkpoint: test the convert_paligemma_checkpoint function with a checkpoint path and output directory
